distinctness.contamination_guard: CONFIRM observations, reference, and oracle remain under tests/confirm and are not copied into environment/input.

semantic_acceptance.metric_layout: Resolve the declared paired-analysis metrics by their task-specific labels across one or more sheets; sheet names and fixed rows are not scored.
semantic_acceptance.paired_difference: One formula-linked raw paired-difference column is sufficient for the paired analysis.
semantic_acceptance.formula_compatibility: Treat Excel _xlfn. and _xlws. compatibility prefixes as semantically inert for supported paired-analysis functions.
semantic_acceptance.chart_binding: Accept a direct paired-difference series or a formula-linked helper series covering every supplied pair.
semantic_acceptance.source_gate: The ten ordered source pairs remain protected; inclusion flags were not requested and are not scored.

protected_source_pairs: the ten ordered group-1/group-2 pairs supplied in the CONFIRM starting workbook
